title: Quick Fungal DNA Extraction from Colonies on Plates
author: Johannes Debler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwprpdm6

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions and autoclave them at 121°C.

substeps.instruction: 1M TrisHCl pH 8.0: Dissolve 12.14 g Tris base (or Trizma base) in deionised H2O up to 100 ml; adjust pH with concentrated HCl.
2M KCl: Dissolve 15.11 g KCl in deionised H2O up to 200 ml.
500 mM NaEDTA (pH 8.0): Dissolve 18.6 g EDTA disodium salt dihydrate in deionised H2O up to 100 ml; adjust pH to 8.0 to ensure solubility.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of Extraction Buffer by combining the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: 50 ml 2M KCl
10 ml 1M Tris-HCl pH 8.0
2 ml 500 mM NaEDTA
Add deionised H2O to reach a final volume of 100 ml.

steps.title: Set Up Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: For each sample, label two 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes and add the following:

substeps.instruction: Tube 1: 500 ul Extraction Buffer and 1 stainless steel bead.
Tube 2: 300 ul Isopropanol.

steps.title: Collect Fungal Sample
steps.instruction: Using a sterile toothpick or pipette tip, collect a fungal colony or mycelia piece (approx. 3-5 mm x 3-5 mm) from a plate and place it into Tube 1.

substeps.instruction: Punch the toothpick through the mycelium to the bottom of the agar plate.
Slice underneath the mycelial mat to minimize agar carryover.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize samples in a MiniG 1600 (SPEX, SP 1600) for 5 min at 1500 rpm.

steps.title: Separate Cell Debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 17,000 x g for 5 min to pellet cell debris.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from Tube 1 to Tube 2 (containing 300 ul Isopropanol).

substeps.instruction: Vortex for 5-10 seconds.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 17,000 x g to pellet the DNA.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 ul 70% Ethanol.
Vortex to mix and ensure the pellet is loose from the bottom of the tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 17,000 x g.

steps.title: Elute and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and recover the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove remaining ethanol using a pipette tip.
Allow leftover ethanol to evaporate for 5-10 min.
Dissolve the pellet in 50-100 ul H2O or 1x TE buffer.
Measure DNA concentration (e.g., Nanodrop) and store at -20°C.
